Generated spec for data-cells

Usage:
  zqk system data-cells [flags]

Flags:
      --envelope-policy-dry-run[=true|false]   Dry run envelope policies for known storage profiles
      --json[=true|false]                      Output in JSON format
      --json-envelope[=true|false]             Output JSON envelope with operational details
      --kind string                            Filter data cells by kind

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded[=true|false]   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
